basePrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: landscape portfolio project illustration, 3:2 aspect ratio.
Primary request: An original contemporary engineering metaphor drawn with the visual language of Leonardo da Vinci's invention notebooks, not a reproduction of an existing manuscript.
Style/medium: meticulous sepia pen-and-ink technical draftsmanship, fine cross-hatching, delicate compass construction lines, small exploded details and sectional views, restrained ochre wash.
Scene/backdrop: warm softly aged ivory parchment, subtle paper grain, clean generous margins.
Composition: one distinctive central invention with two or three small supporting technical studies, all important details inside the central 80 percent so the drawing reads at card size.
Palette: warm parchment, walnut-brown ink, muted amber, no bright colors.
Constraints: beautiful coherent vintage workshop study, no readable text, no labels, no numbers, no signatures, no watermark, no logos, no decorative border, no dark photographic desk, no UI. This is a conceptual illustration, not a factual architecture diagram.
Subject:

assets.description: Folio, lentes y fragmentos conectados a un archivo de evidencias.
assets.subject: An open folio on a mechanical reading desk, pages split into strips which pass through two brass lenses and converge into a small evidence cabinet; threads visibly connect answers back to source pages.

assets.description: Cámaras cúbicas y anillos de un clúster mecánico en vista explotada.
assets.subject: An exploded spherical orrery assembled from small cubic chambers, circular orchestration rings, repairable joints and a central helm; a coherent mechanical cluster, not an atom symbol.

assets.description: Antena y embudos que ordenan señales en un archivo.
assets.subject: A delicate directional antenna and three listening funnels collecting scattered marks, sorting them through sieves into a structured archive; a pulse trace on a narrow paper reel.

assets.description: Casa en corte, llave y mecanismo de citas.
assets.subject: A cutaway miniature house with doors and rooms, a mechanical assistant arm offering a key, and a small rotating appointment wheel.

assets.description: Prensa y guías mecánicas que separan y reúnen páginas.
assets.subject: An ingenious document workshop: open folios, brass cutting guides, a manual binding press, individual pages splitting apart and recombining; one clear central mechanical invention.

assets.description: Rotor, placas y batería conectados mediante líneas de energía.
assets.subject: An interconnected energy apparatus with a wind rotor, solar collecting plates, an electrochemical battery cross-section and transmission pylons, power flows drawn as fine ink paths.

assets.description: Proyector óptico y fotogramas que forman una cinta de movimiento.
assets.subject: An exploded early optical projector with sequential film frames advancing through gears; still image plates transform into a continuous strip of moving images.

assets.description: Balanza y lentes para examinar dos recorridos de datos.
assets.subject: A precise balance scale integrated with a magnifying lens and two mirrored data sorting chambers, measuring asymmetric weights; a rigorous instrument of auditing, no human subjects.

assets.description: Escudo mecánico, engranajes y libro de reglas de auditoría.
assets.subject: A shield-shaped mechanical inspection gate, small dependency gears entering through it, an open rulebook and a final audit scroll.

assets.description: Lupa mecánica que organiza fragmentos de expedientes sin datos personales.
assets.subject: A brass magnifying apparatus reading a closed administrative folio with entirely abstract blank fields, organizing page fragments into drawers; no confidential content or people.

assets.description: Diafragmas, diapasón y cinta de ondas para estudiar la voz.
assets.subject: Two resonant brass diaphragms connected by a dissected waveform ribbon, tuning forks and an acoustic horn; a study of voice timbre as an engineering instrument.

assets.description: Autómata de palancas que controla tres módulos de infraestructura.
assets.subject: A cloud-shaped brass automaton controlling three separate miniature resource chambers through articulated levers and command cams.

assets.description: Arquitectura en capas con red, cómputo y cámara de datos.
assets.subject: An exploded three-tier architectural model with separate foundation networks, computing chambers, a load distribution balance and a protected data vault.

assets.description: Cadena de montaje con inspección y entrega de una caja modular.
assets.subject: A mechanical assembly line with three distinct stations: source gears, an optical quality inspection gate and a sealed delivery crate; fine arrows show the sequence.

assets.description: Disco, mecanismo musical y trazos de correlación.
assets.subject: A vinyl record dissected into concentric waveform grooves, a small piano key mechanism, a sound horn and geometric correlation plots; a poetic anatomical study of music.

assets.description: Plataformas móviles y trayectorias probabilísticas de un ranking.
assets.subject: A stepped ranking tower with movable platforms, a probability funnel scattering small beads into alternative paths, repeated faint trajectories showing uncertain positions.

assets.description: Mapa de Europa con columnas y trayectorias demográficas.
assets.subject: A recognizable unlabeled outline map of Europe overlaid with small population columns and branching demographic trajectories, plus a probability wheel.

assets.description: Bocina y mecanismo que condensan una cinta sonora en pocas hojas.
assets.subject: An acoustic horn feeding a long waveform ribbon into a compact mechanical condenser that produces a short stack of abstract text sheets.

assets.description: Pluma cuyos trazos pasan por una cámara y se convierten en ondas.
assets.subject: A fountain pen laying down abstract ink strokes which transform through a resonant brass chamber into expanding sound waves; a text-to-voice invention.

assets.description: Carrete sonoro, rueda de segmentos y mecanismo de transcripción.
assets.subject: A wound audio reel passing through a segmentation wheel into a typewriter-like transcription mechanism, with short paper strips emerging in sequence.

assets.description: Cimientos y corredores separados bajo un pabellón de documentos.
assets.subject: A cutaway foundation under a small archive pavilion: private and public corridors, connected chambers, a bridge and protective perimeter; infrastructure as an architectural plan.

assets.description: Páginas fragmentadas sobre una retícula que convergen en una lente.
assets.subject: An open book with separated page fragments hovering over a geometric coordinate lattice, a question-shaped curved pointer retrieving matching fragments into a reading lens.

assets.description: Instrumento energético, globo y curvas de proyección por habitante.
assets.subject: An energy surveying instrument facing a small globe, a per-person energy scale and several historical-to-future projection curves; a careful academic engineering study without numerical claims.

assets.description: Semilla mecánica que conecta documentos con un índice geométrico.
assets.subject: A small seed-shaped indexing mechanism growing branching document strips into a geometric vector lattice and an organized cabinet of tiny drawers.

assets.description: Lente que transforma marcas de una imagen en tipos móviles.
assets.subject: A large optical lens scanning abstract block-like glyphs on a sheet, reconstructing them as clean movable type pieces on the opposite side.

assets.description: Banco de mantenimiento con engranajes, medidor y cajones de paquetes.
assets.subject: A cutaway maintenance workbench with interlocking gears, a diagnostic gauge, wrench and orderly package drawers; a simple repeatable servicing mechanism, no mascot or logo.

assets.description: Tres cámaras de máquinas dentro de una caja anfitriona en vista explotada.
assets.subject: Three miniature virtual machine chambers nested inside a larger transparent host box, an exploded configuration plate and provisioning levers; a local experimental laboratory.
